headline: Vaxtex Cotfab announces shareholder postal ballot
hook: Vaxtex Cotfab initiates postal ballot process
summary: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited has formally notified the stock exchange regarding the issuance of a postal ballot notice. This process allows shareholders to vote on company resolutions without attending a physical meeting. The specific resolutions to be voted upon were not detailed in the initial exchange filing. Shareholders should review the upcoming documentation to understand the impact on company governance.
whats_next: Release of the detailed postal ballot notice and voting schedule.
why_it_matters: Shareholders can vote on upcoming company resolutions via postal ballot.
